topics.label: Lecture Introduction: Cancer Evolution and the Microenvironment
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture framework and learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution, cell of origin, and microenvironmental influences.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Mechanisms in Cancer Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer progresses through Darwinian clonal selection of driver mutations and non-mutational epigenetic changes.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore tissue hierarchies and evaluate experimental evidence for cancer stem cells and cell-of-origin transformation in leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion, Stromal Dependence, and Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments promote and sustain tumor growth, how these cellular interactions are profiled, and how microenvironmental coevolution drives malignancy.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Preview of Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the lecture and provides an administrative transition to the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
